meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你要求或提示时对网页和终端界面做视觉质检：先捕获截图或终端文本证据，用脚本做差异对比，再派两个只读审查分别检查设计系统/功能和视觉保真度/CJK，最后给出通过或修改的判定。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改任何界面后，或问某个页面/组件/TUI 是否看起来正确时触发；说出“visual QA”“UI looks wrong”“design system check”等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个页面和设计稿是否一致。
say.note: 会截图对比并派审查员检查设计系统。

say.text: 看看这个界面有没有 CJK 文字被截断或错位。
say.note: 会重点检查中日韩文字渲染和布局。

say.text: 检查终端界面的边框和列对齐。
say.note: 会捕获终端文本并检查溢出与对齐。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude performs visual QA on web or terminal UIs when requested: it captures screenshots or terminal text, runs diff scripts, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK), then returns a pass/revise/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI, or when asked whether a page/component/TUI looks right. Also on keywords like 'visual QA', 'UI looks wrong', 'design system check', or 'CJK text clipping'.

say_en.text: Check this page against the design mock.
say_en.note: It captures screenshots and compares, then reviews design tokens.

say_en.text: Check whether CJK text is clipped or misaligned.
say_en.note: It focuses on East Asian text rendering and layout.

say_en.text: Check terminal borders and column alignment.
say_en.note: It captures terminal text and checks overflow and alignment.
